svg.aria-label: LOCAL AI verified source architecture map, eight implementation paths, October 2026
svg.text: Open WebUI and OpenCode are separate interfaces. Both use the same gateway, serialized local inference and mode policy.
Optional integrations require individual activation. A working repository is not proof of acceptance on the owner’s Mac.
Scoped copies, diff and test data;
Local output + vault if set up
Plan reads; Build asks for writes;
Modules and interfaces described above exist in the inspected main release; connections follow its implementation guides.
VPN browser, desktop, Office, vault, Discord, remote access and external helper retain explicit setup or approvals.
Real Mac GPU/memory, Apple Events, Playwright/VPN drop, provider permission/selectors and voice remain hardware checks.
SOURCE: github.com/MisterDataScience/local-ai-environment- | README.md; docs/GATEWAY-STRUCTURE.md; WORK-AGENT.md; RELEASE-VALIDATION.md; SCOPED-AUTOMATION.md; feature-specific docs
